csp_header: default-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' blob: data:; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self';

eval_isolation.reason: Emscripten dynamic linker (ASM_CONSTS for libRlapack.so and libRblas.so) evaluates dynamic asm stubs inside worker scope

threat_mitigation: Worker is isolated from DOM, cookies, localStorage and page credentials. Strict connect-src self prevents worker network egress.
